# How-To Geek

> How-To Geek explains technology with practical how-to articles, reviews, news, and answers for everyday users and enthusiasts.

How-To Geek publishes tutorials, explainers, product reviews, buying advice, and technology news across operating systems, apps, hardware, smart home, streaming, and consumer electronics. Its content is organized into topic hubs and article archives that help readers solve problems, learn features, and make informed purchasing decisions.

## Main
- [Homepage](https://www.howtogeek.com/): Main entry point for technology guides, reviews, news, and featured articles.
- [Latest](https://www.howtogeek.com/latest/): Reverse-chronological feed of newly published articles across all categories.
- [News](https://www.howtogeek.com/category/news/): Technology news coverage on software, hardware, platforms, and industry developments.
- [Reviews](https://www.howtogeek.com/category/reviews/): Product reviews covering gadgets, accessories, PCs, software, and services.
- [Explainers](https://www.howtogeek.com/category/explainers/): Concept-focused articles that clarify technical topics, features, and terminology.
- [Buying Guides](https://www.howtogeek.com/category/buying-guides/): Recommendations and comparisons for choosing tech products and services.

## Operating Systems
- [Windows](https://www.howtogeek.com/category/windows/): Tutorials, troubleshooting, tips, and feature guides for Microsoft Windows.
- [Windows 10](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/windows-10/): Articles focused on Windows 10 setup, settings, and problem solving.
- [Windows 11](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/windows-11/): Coverage of Windows 11 features, customization, and troubleshooting.
- [Mac](https://www.howtogeek.com/category/mac/): How-to guides and tips for macOS, Mac apps, and Apple desktops.
- [Linux](https://www.howtogeek.com/category/linux/): Linux tutorials, command-line help, distro coverage, and system administration basics.
- [Chrome OS](https://www.howtogeek.com/category/chrome-os/): Chromebook and ChromeOS guides for settings, apps, and workflows.

## Mobile
- [Android](https://www.howtogeek.com/category/android/): Android phone and tablet tutorials, app tips, and device advice.
- [iPhone & iPad](https://www.howtogeek.com/category/iphone-ipad/): iOS and iPadOS guides covering settings, apps, and troubleshooting.
- [Samsung Galaxy](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/samsung-galaxy/): Tips and how-tos for Samsung Galaxy phones, tablets, and features.
- [Google Pixel](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/google-pixel/): Pixel-focused guides, feature explanations, and device recommendations.
- [Mobile Apps](https://www.howtogeek.com/category/apps/): App tutorials and recommendations across mobile and desktop platforms.

## Apps & Productivity
- [Microsoft Office](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/microsoft-office/): Guides for Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Office features.
- [Microsoft Excel](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/microsoft-excel/): Spreadsheet tutorials, formulas, formatting, and productivity techniques.
- [Google Docs](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/google-docs/): Help articles for document editing, collaboration, and formatting in Google Docs.
- [Google Sheets](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/google-sheets/): Spreadsheet tips, formulas, and workflow guides for Google Sheets.
- [Web Browsers](https://www.howtogeek.com/category/web-browsers/): Browser tips, privacy settings, extensions, and troubleshooting guides.
- [Google Chrome](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/google-chrome/): Chrome tutorials for settings, tabs, extensions, and performance.
- [Mozilla Firefox](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/mozilla-firefox/): Firefox guides covering privacy, customization, and browser features.

## Hardware & PCs
- [PC Hardware](https://www.howtogeek.com/category/pc-hardware/): Coverage of components, upgrades, compatibility, and desktop hardware advice.
- [Laptops](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/laptops/): Laptop reviews, buying advice, and setup or troubleshooting articles.
- [Desktop PCs](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/desktop-pcs/): Articles on desktop systems, upgrades, maintenance, and recommendations.
- [Monitors](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/monitors/): Monitor reviews, buying tips, and display setup guidance.
- [Keyboards](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/keyboards/): Keyboard reviews, comparisons, and usage tips.
- [Mice](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/mice/): Mouse reviews, recommendations, and productivity or gaming advice.
- [Storage](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/storage/): SSD, HDD, external drive, and storage management articles.

## Smart Home & Networking
- [Smart Home](https://www.howtogeek.com/category/smart-home/): Guides for connected home devices, automation, and setup.
- [Wi-Fi & Routers](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/wi-fi/): Wireless networking tips, router advice, and connectivity troubleshooting.
- [Networking](https://www.howtogeek.com/category/networking/): Home networking explainers, setup guides, and security basics.
- [Mesh Wi-Fi](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/mesh-wi-fi/): Articles on mesh systems, coverage, and home network planning.
- [Security Cameras](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/security-cameras/): Reviews and setup guides for smart cameras and monitoring devices.
- [Smart Speakers](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/smart-speakers/): Buying advice and how-tos for voice assistants and speaker platforms.

## Streaming & Entertainment
- [Streaming](https://www.howtogeek.com/category/streaming/): Guides to streaming devices, services, apps, and media playback.
- [Netflix](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/netflix/): Netflix tips, feature guides, and service-related news.
- [YouTube](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/youtube/): Tutorials and explainers for YouTube features, settings, and usage.
- [Spotify](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/spotify/): Spotify tips, playlists, settings, and subscription guidance.
- [Plex](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/plex/): Plex server setup, streaming workflows, and media library management.
- [Cord Cutting](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/cord-cutting/): Advice for replacing cable with streaming services and devices.

## Gaming
- [Gaming](https://www.howtogeek.com/category/gaming/): News, reviews, and guides for PC, console, and cloud gaming.
- [PC Gaming](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/pc-gaming/): PC gaming hardware, settings, storefronts, and performance tips.
- [Steam](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/steam/): Steam tutorials, account tips, and platform feature guides.
- [Nintendo Switch](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/nintendo-switch/): Switch-related news, accessories, and gameplay or setup advice.
- [PlayStation](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/playstation/): PlayStation guides, console settings, and accessory coverage.
- [Xbox](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/xbox/): Xbox tutorials, subscription explainers, and console tips.

## Security & Privacy
- [Security](https://www.howtogeek.com/category/security/): Articles on cybersecurity, account safety, scams, and protective practices.
- [Privacy](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/privacy/): Privacy-focused explainers for apps, devices, browsers, and online services.
- [Passwords](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/passwords/): Password management advice, best practices, and account security tips.
- [VPN](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/vpn/): VPN explainers, recommendations, and setup guidance.
- [Two-Factor Authentication](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/two-factor-authentication/): Guides to enabling and using 2FA across services.
- [Scams](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/scams/): Warnings and explainers about phishing, fraud, and online threats.

## DIY, Linux & Advanced Topics
- [Raspberry Pi](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/raspberry-pi/): Raspberry Pi projects, setup tutorials, and hardware experiments.
- [Docker](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/docker/): Container basics, commands, and self-hosting tutorials using Docker.
- [Self-Hosting](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/self-hosting/): Guides for running services at home on servers and NAS devices.
- [NAS](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/nas/): Network-attached storage setup, backups, and media server articles.
- [Command Line](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/command-line/): Shell and terminal tutorials for Windows, macOS, and Linux users.
- [Open Source](https://www.howtogeek.com/tag/open-source/): Coverage of open-source software, tools, and ecosystem developments.
